whyItMatters: Assigning to innerHTML parses a string as HTML. Attacker-influenced data in that string becomes live markup and script (XSS).
actions: Use textContent for text so the value is never parsed.
For real markup, build DOM nodes explicitly or sanitize with a maintained allowlist sanitizer first.
Re-run a SAST scan and confirm DPK-SAST-002 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no innerHTML assignment remains in the changed files.

example.caveat: textContent drops all markup; if markup is genuinely required, sanitize before assigning.
